canonical_project: New Meghalaya State Data Centre at ICCC Building, Umsawli, New Shillong
owner: Department of Information Technology, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT news archive dated 7 June 2025 invited online bids for design, site preparation, supply, installation, configuration, testing, training, setup, operations and maintenance of MSDC at ICCC Building, Umsawli, New Shillong. TCIL EOI dated 23 June 2025 references client tender MITS/2025/2-B for the same work; tender aggregator details mention 120 kVA UPS, 250 kVA DG set, racks, storage and physical/IT infrastructure but no MW capacity.
